ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Power, CardRarity.Rare, TargetType.Self)` (Entropy.cs:18-21) == cost 1 / POWER / RARE / SELF.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new CardsVar(1)` (Entropy.cs:16) == `_cards = 1`, read as `IntValue` at the apply site.

OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<EntropyPower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, DynamicVars.Cards.IntValue, Owner.Creature, this)` (Entropy.cs:25) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, EntropyPower, self._cards, applier=ctx.player)`. No animation trigger on either side. EntropyPower's start-of-turn transform belongs to the power stream -- and note that transform is where creature_card_cmds G3 (deck transforms bypass the deck-entry hooks) lives, but that is an in-COMBAT transform here, not a deck one.

OnUpgrade.rationale: `AddKeyword(CardKeyword.Innate)` (Entropy.cs:30) == `self.innate = True`, and unlike card/aggression this card DOES re-seed the flag in `_init_vars` (`self.innate = False`, colorless_powers.py:84), so `downgrade()` restores it -- confirmed by `py audit/tools/card_probes.py downgrade`, which does not list entropy.
